title: Pictures on the research news
text: Research news now shows photos of the prize winners and the science behind them, each freely licensed from Wikimedia Commons and credited to its photographer with its licence. Items without a free photo get our own drawing.

title: Two new guides for applicants from any country
text: Visa money, work hours and staying after graduation compared across ten countries, and how funded PhDs work in Europe: salaried posts, doctoral fellowships and scholarships, with a checklist for reading a PhD advert.

title: New: research and innovation news
text: A new page explains the year's major research prizes and new funding in plain English, from the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine and the Fields Medals to the Kavli and Breakthrough Prizes, each with its official source and why it matters for students.

title: New: funded PhD and research positions
text: A new page lists salaried PhD posts, doctoral fellowships and postdocs: 17 to start, at Lund, Uppsala, Oslo, Copenhagen and ETH Zurich. Researchers can post their own funded positions for free.

title: Country guides: visa money, work rights and staying after graduation
text: All ten country guides now open with an at-a-glance box and answer common questions: the proof of funds for the student visa, how many hours you may work, and how long you can stay to look for a job.

title: New route: Bowdoin College (USA)
text: Need-blind admission for international applicants, with 100% of calculated need met and no loans. Early Decision 1 closes on 15 November; Early Decision 2 and Regular Decision close on 5 January.

title: New route: Danish Government Scholarships
text: Tuition waivers and grants towards living costs for highly qualified non-EU/EEA students on full degree programmes. Each Danish university selects its own scholars and sets its own dates.

title: DAAD: doctoral rate in the EPOS call
text: DAAD's EPOS call lists €1,400 a month for doctoral candidates from February 2026, up from €1,300. Its general scholarship overview still lists €1,300.

title: TU Wien: non-EU application windows
text: The winter semester 2026/27 window for non-EU/EEA applicants closed on 15 July 2026. The summer semester 2027 window runs from 16 July 2026 to 15 January 2027. Costs, documents and questions added.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at ASU: 2027–28 call closed
text: Applications for the 2027–28 cohort closed on 27 September 2026 at 23:59 GMT. The page now says so.

title: Costs, documents and questions on 13 route pages
text: Thirteen route pages gained costs, the documents to prepare and answers to common questions.

title: DegreeStep moved to degreestep.com
text: The site now lives at its own address. Old links forward automatically.
